Load Data:

```{r}
df_url="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jmayberr/math133-stat-learning-fall2026/refs/heads/main/Datasets/fantasy2025.csv"
fantasy2025=read.csv(df_url) |>
  drop_na()
n=nrow(fantasy2025)
s=sample(n,0.7*n)
train=fantasy2025[s,]
test=fantasy2025[-s,]
```

Convert train/test set to torch objects

```{r}
library(torch)
x_train = torch_tensor(
  as.matrix(train[,16:29]),
  dtype = torch_float()
)

x_test = torch_tensor(
  as.matrix(test[, 16:29]),
  dtype = torch_float()
)


y_train = torch_tensor(
  as.matrix(train$fantasy_points_ppr),
  dtype = torch_float()
)

y_test = torch_tensor(
  as.matrix(test$fantasy_points_ppr),
  dtype = torch_float()
)
```

Define neural network architecture:

```{r}
points_nn=nn_sequential(
  #Define input to hidden layer dimensions
  nn_linear(14,32),
  nn_relu(),
  nn_linear(32,16),
  nn_relu(),
  
  # Hidden layer to output
  nn_linear(16,1)
  
)
```

Define model, loss function and optimizer:

```{r}
model = points_nn

# Use mean squared for regression
loss_fn = nn_mse_loss()

optimizer = optim_adam(
  model$parameters,
  lr = 0.01
)
```

Run optimization:

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
epochs = 1000

loss_history = data.frame(
  epoch = 1:epochs,
  loss = NA
)

for (epoch in 1:epochs) {
  # Reset gradient from previous epoch
  optimizer$zero_grad()
    
  # Compute current model output
  output = model(x_train) 
    
  #Compute current model loss 
  loss = loss_fn(output, y_train) 
    
  # Compute current loss gradient via backpropagation
  loss$backward()

  # Perform one step of gradient descent
  optimizer$step()

  # Store loss
  loss_history$loss[epoch] = loss$item()
}

loss_history |>
  ggplot(aes(x=epoch,y=loss))+
  geom_point(shape=1,size=1)+
  geom_line()
```

Calculate predicted values:

```{r}
# Calculate raw model output
yhat=as_array(model(x_test))
y=test$fantasy_points_ppr

#rmse
sqrt(mean((y-yhat)^2))

#R2
ybar=mean(test$fantasy_points_ppr)
SST=sum((y-ybar)^2)
SSE=sum((y-yhat)^2)
1-SSE/SST

```
```{r}
train2=train[,c(7,16:29)]
points_lm=lm(fantasy_points_ppr~.,data=train2)

yhat=predict(points_lm,newdata=test)
y=test$fantasy_points_ppr

sqrt(mean((y-yhat)^2))
ybar=mean(test$fantasy_points_ppr)
SST=sum((y-ybar)^2)
SSE=sum((y-yhat)^2)
1-SSE/SST
```
